Fragrance family of Armaf Club de Nuit Lionheart Man perfume
Armaf Club de Nuit Lionheart Man perfume belongs to the Woody Oriental fragrance group , with a delicate combination of fresh, sweet and warm notes, creating a seductive and powerful scent experience, very suitable for modern, confident and charismatic men. Below is a detailed analysis of the fragrance group of this perfume:

Top notes : Opens with the fresh, pleasant scent of lavender and mint . Lavender brings a relaxing, pleasant and elegant feeling, while mint adds a sharp and cool touch, creating a fresh wave, bringing a refreshing and energetic feeling from the first moments of spraying Armaf Club de Nuit Lionheart Man perfume.
Middle notes : As the top notes of Armaf Club de Nuit Lionheart Man perfume gradually subside, the middle notes appear with the warmth and sweetness of benzoin and vanilla . Benzoin brings a warm, rich, slightly sweet like resin, combined with vanilla to create a soft, sweet and pleasant but not too strong. This combination creates a layer of scent that is both seductive and luxurious, like a warm and pleasant cloak.
Base notes : Leaving a strong and lasting impression is the combination of honey , tonka bean and tobacco . Honey brings sweetness, while tonka bean with its gentle, warm scent like vanilla bean adds depth and smoothness to Armaf Club de Nuit Lionheart Man perfume. Finally, the tobacco scent brings a deep, mysterious note, reminiscent of a strong, confident man, ready to face any challenge.
Thanks to the harmonious combination of fresh, sweet and warm notes, Armaf Club de Nuit Lionheart Man is an ideal choice for those looking for a strong, confident scent that is still sophisticated and seductive.
